## About Me

Master's student in Software Engineering at Universität Hildesheim with one year of professional experience as an Associate AI Engineer. My work spans **computer vision**, **deep learning**, and **NLP**, with hands-on experience building and deploying end-to-end ML pipelines using PyTorch and TensorFlow. Awarded First Prize at the 2023 University Project Competition for a funded computer vision system. Currently exploring agentic AI and LLM-based systems. Open to Werkstudent and internship roles in AI, ML, and computer vision.

## Featured Projects

### ♻️ Computer Vision Smart Bin &nbsp; `🏆 First Prize · University Funded`

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," width="100%" alt="Smart Bin pipeline"/>

> Developed an innovative smart bin integrating computer vision with Arduino to automatically separate waste into compartments. Trained a custom deep learning model achieving **96% test accuracy** using Python, PyTorch, and OpenCV. Selected for university funding as part of the 2023 project competition award.

### 🪪 Electronic Identity Verification (eKYC)

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," width="100%" alt="eKYC pipeline"/>

> Web application for electronic identity verification — extracts and stores CNIC data into a MySQL database via OCR, then performs face comparison between the ID card photo and a live face scan. Deployed as a full Flask web application with a clean user interface.
